svg.aria-label: claude-skills: Claude Code skills. Home of sound-notify, which plays a sound when Claude finishes a task. Default: “Faaaah”, bass boosted. 247 Indian meme sounds bundled. One command swaps the default. Ships to ~/.claude, 2026. github.com/saifdev9/claude-skills.
